name: BSc Engineering (EBE)
notes: 2027: Band C possible admission from 420 FPS (600 scale); Band A from 500. Physical Sciences 75% for Electrical / E&CE / Mechatronics streams (70% for Civil). NBTs (MAT, AL, QL) must be written. Technical Mathematics/Science cannot replace Mathematics/Physical Sciences.

name: BSc (Science)
notes: 2027 Science faculty: FPS out of 800 (doubled Mathematics & Physical Sciences). Band C from 550; Band A from 660. NBTs required (not used for admission but for extended programme placement). Some majors allow IT instead of Physical Sciences — see prospectus.

name: BSc (Computer Science)
notes: Same faculty FPS (800) and subject minima as general BSc; major-specific rules may allow Information Technology in place of Physical Sciences for this stream — see Faculty of Science.

name: BCom
notes: 2027: Band C (EDU only) from 430 FPS; mainstream Band A from 435. English FAL minimum 60% (stricter than HL 50%) — calculator cannot tell HL vs FAL; check your case. NBT AL & QL Upper Intermediate+ required for all Commerce applicants.

name: BCom (Accounting)
notes: Shares 2027 Commerce faculty FPS bands with other BCom/BBusSci streams (except Actuarial / Quant Finance and except Computer Science & Statistics specialisations — see prospectus).

name: LLB
notes: 2027 undergraduate LLB: Band C possible admission from 470 FPS; Band A from 500 (SA). NBT: Proficient AL and Intermediate+ QL (SA Band A/B). International probable admission guideline 510+ FPS. No separate English % table for NSC beyond general FPS competition.

name: BA
notes: 2027: Band C from 380 FPS; English FAL minimum 60% if not HL — enter your English % accordingly. NBT Academic Literacy Intermediate+ (Band C). PPE and some majors need higher marks (e.g. Mathematics 60% for PPE).

name: Teaching pathway (UG + PGCE)
notes: UCT does not offer a generic undergraduate BEd in this prospectus; initial teaching is typically a degree (e.g. BA/BSc) plus Postgraduate Certificate in Education. Requirements shown are aligned with general Humanities BA entry for planning purposes.

name: Health Sciences (MBChB-oriented minimums)
notes: 2027 MBChB: sub-minimum APS 450 (six subject % rule differs from FPS); FPS out of 900 includes NBT (not in this calculator). Next three best subjects at 70%+ also required. Other health programmes (OT, physio, etc.) use lower thresholds — see Faculty of Health Sciences.

name: BSc (Mathematics)
notes: Faculty of Science FPS (800 scale) and minimum subject marks as for 2027 BSc.

name: BSc (Statistics / Data Science)
notes: Same faculty minima as BSc. Commerce BCom streams in Statistics & Data Science use higher school Maths (70%) and higher FPS bands — use Commerce programmes for that route.

name: BCom (Economics)
notes: Economics major at UCT also needs 60% NSC Mathematics for the major (separate from faculty offer); NBT and English FAL rules as per Commerce.

name: BBusSci
notes: 2027: same faculty FPS entry table as BCom except Actuarial Science / Quantitative Finance and except Computer Science & Statistics specialisations.

name: Built Environment (BAS / Construction / Property)
notes: 2027 Band C floors vary by programme (BAS 348 FPS; Construction / Property 390; BAS also needs portfolio). Using the lowest published Band C (348) — verify against your specific stream.

name: BSc (Physics)
notes: 2027 Faculty of Science minimum FPS and subject requirements.

name: BCom / BBusSci (Computer Science or Statistics & Data Science)
notes: 2027 Commerce table: Mathematics 70% and FPS bands same as other Commerce streams (Band C EDU 430–434). English FAL 60% if applicable. NBT AL & QL Upper Intermediate+.

name: BCom / BBusSci (Actuarial Science or Quantitative Finance)
notes: 2027: Band C (EDU) 475–479 FPS; Band A from 500. English FAL 80% with Proficient NBT AL & QL when using FAL — see prospectus. NBT requirements apply.
